trigger: another actor (operator or reconciler) contains this host between the ceremony's `before==inactive` read and its own `quarantine` dispatch
summary: main() discards the `quarantine` dispatch answer. A host already `active` answers `note|already_active=1` (firewall_quarantine_parsers.hpp:3921, verified by code read) with an unchanged record; the ceremony reads status active, ok=True, then releases a containment it did not apply and exits 0. Reporter derived I1/HIGH (native MEDIUM); the recorder notes the applicability of I1 (a product control does not fail; an authorised operator-run tool lifts a containment) is the adjudication question, and no de-escalation is recorded. Proposed fix: capture the apply answer; if this agent's SUCCESS rows carry note already_active=1 / repaired=1 / incomplete_apply_converged=1, skip release_and_confirm, print that the host was contained by another actor and was NOT released, and return EXIT_FAIL; if the answer is missing still release (lifting is the safe direction).

trigger: a cumulative dashboard stall of about 270 s or more (floor 300 vs a 290 s nominal budget, default ttl 300) lets the agent TTL tick release the host first
summary: `proven` (release_succeeded) is true for an idempotent no-op release: after the TTL tick erases the record a manual release loads `absent`, adds `note|no_state_record=1` (firewall_quarantine_parsers.hpp:4250) and answers status|inactive rc 0. The run exits 0 although its own release did nothing. The ttl_expired=1 note is NOT a discriminator (agent-local tick only); no_state_record=1 is. Reporter derived I3/HIGH (native LOW); recorder note: the sudoers grants are exercised by the TTL release too, so the privilege-regression claim is weaker than the false-pass claim; no de-escalation recorded. Proposed fix: in release_and_confirm set proven only if this agent's SUCCESS release row output has status|inactive and no `note|no_state_record=1` / `note|state_unreadable=1` line; keep the release-unproven branch (exit 1) for it; add tests with a release reply carrying note|no_state_record=1 (exit 1) and one without (exit 0). Also see g9-release-unproven-msg-time-limit-wrong.
